fields.statement: Verifier at 559ffa93: go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestMake' -v passed TestMakeUpdateDryRun, TestMakeTestTimeout (its code untouched: the diff to makeupdate_test.go only adds lines) and the new TestMakeTestShardTargets, which runs make -n on test-scripts, test-rest, test-budgets and lint and asserts -trimpath plus the budget -skip or -run regex, checks test-api's SHARD=1/2 and 2/2 regexes (via GO_TEST=echo) cover go test -list's internal/api tests exactly once with no budget test, and checks test-budgets prints a fake go's RHIZA_BUDGET_LOG under 'Read-budget timings'. By hand: make test-api SHARD=1/2 GO_TEST=echo prints an anchored ^(...)$ -run with -trimpath; SHARD=3/2 exits non-zero with a usage error; make -n lint runs gofmt -l, go vet and the self-check build; the test target is unchanged. Read the diff: test-rest skips budgets and TestScripts across every package but internal/api, so the four test targets cover make test's tests. Note: in test-api, go test -list's failure is masked by the pipe to sort (no pipefail), so a compile error in internal/api makes a test-api shard report 'no tests' and pass; test-budgets and lint (vet) still fail CI on it.
